senses.gloss: (b. h.) to hide; to retire.—Part. pass. צָנוּעַ.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 16a:4">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite> (commenting on the custom of bringing the chest containing the Torah scrolls to the open place of the town for fasts and prayers) <he>לומר כלי צ׳ היה לנו וכ׳</he> as if saying, we had a vessel kept in reverential retirement, and it has been exposed on account of our sins.—V. <cite ref="R00611"><he>צָנוּעַ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:1">Sabb. X, 1</cite> <he>המַצְנִיעַ לזרע וכ׳</he> if a person had laid aside something for seed, or for a sample, or for medicinal purposes, and takes it out into the street &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 90b:8">Ib. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>שהִצְנִיעוֹ ושכח וכ׳</he> if he had laid it aside, but forgot for what purpose &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 91a:1-3">Ib. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … להַצְנִיעוֹ ואין מַצְנִיעִין וכ׳</he> a thing not fit for reservation, or of the kind not usually reserved, but this person considered it fit &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:3">Num. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מַצְנַעַת עצמה</he> keeps herself in retirement (chastity).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>הִצְנִיעוּ עצמן</he> contained themselves (remained chaste); a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מוּצְנָע</he>; f. <he>מוּצְנַעַת</he> &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 8:8">Ter. VIII, 8</cite> <he>מקום המ׳</he> a retired (well-guarded and clean) place; <cite ref="Bekhorot 33b">Bekh. 33ᵇ</cite>, a. e.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 35:24">Ex. XXXV, 24</cite>) <he>מלמד שהיו מ׳ וכ׳</he> this shows that acacia wood was kept by them in reserve from the days of Jacob; a. e.—
Gen. R. s. 1 (ref. to אמון, Prov. VIII, 30) אמון מוצנע amon (= amun) means well cared for (by ref. to אֹמֵן, Esth. II, 7).

senses.gloss: to restrain. Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ מי הוא זה שבא לצַנְּעֵינוּ וכ׳ who is he that comes to put us under restrictions in our own house?
